notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Since launch I've fixed a few bugs and made some small improvements. Here they are!

Fixed wall and ceiling shaders to work properly on Steamdeck

Published a controller mapping for Steamdeck on Steam Workshop

Added the highly requested start menu

Removed a "grey screen" on game load
